steps: Plan detector locations: every bedroom, hallway, and level of the home.
Turn off power at the breaker if hardwiring; verify with a tester.
Mount the new base plate and connect the wiring harness/pigtail.
Pair each unit with the manufacturer's app and assign it to a room.
Test all units and set up mobile alerts.
